people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
translations.bsb: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.
translations.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
translations.asv: and he was seen for many days of them that came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses unto the people.
